source.root_license: MIT; per-skill licenses differ; inspect individual frontmatter
source.retrieval: Read-only GitHub connector, pinned blob URLs. No source scripts executed.

evaluation_question: Under the scenario's stated environment, is the advertised requested completion reachable while following applicable instructions? Compliant refusal is distinct from requested completion. Unspecified prerequisites remain unknown rather than false.
limitations: No execution claims or measured biological/service success. Explicit synthetic deployments are constructed probes, not naturally observed source faults.
The three natural cases are observational documentation scenarios, not captured user executions.
Source field signatures quoted by the skill are documented evidence, not proof of a live installed tool manifest.

cases.scenario: Preprocess measured RNA counts with Scanpy, preserve counts in AnnData, fit SCVI using the count layer, and export its representation.
assumptions: All named Python packages and selected model dependencies are already installed and compatible with pinned skill versions; CPU, memory, local file access and sufficient training time are available.

Cells/features are unique, batch metadata complete, dataset nondegenerate and QC/feature selection criteria valid. Outcome concerns a mechanically completed model fit/export, not biological validation or convergence guarantees.
Measured unnormalized counts and provenance are available; normalization modifies X only, while layers['counts'] remains available.
cases.selection_rationale: Exercise documented intended coactivation with separate matrix representations.

cases.scenario: Fit SCVI and export its representation using the only available RNA dataset.
assumptions: All named Python packages and selected model dependencies are already installed and compatible with pinned skill versions; CPU, memory, local file access and sufficient training time are available.

Cells/features are unique, batch metadata complete, dataset nondegenerate and QC/feature selection criteria valid. Outcome concerns a mechanically completed model fit/export, not biological validation or convergence guarantees.
Only normalized log1p expression remains. No measured counts or counts layer exist; there is no route to retrieve the originals. Completion must use SCVI, not a substitute model.

cases.scenario: Fit SysVI for substantial cross-system effects using normalized log1p expression and export its representation.
assumptions: All named Python packages and selected model dependencies are already installed and compatible with pinned skill versions; CPU, memory, local file access and sufficient training time are available.

Cells/features are unique, batch metadata complete, dataset nondegenerate and QC/feature selection criteria valid. Outcome concerns a mechanically completed model fit/export, not biological validation or convergence guarantees.
The SysVI-specific input is normalized log1p expression with known provenance and complete system metadata. No requirement to use SCVI.
cases.selection_rationale: Exercise the explicit model-specific representation exception.

cases.scenario: A user requests Scanpy preprocessing followed by scvi-tools integration; no model or available data representation is specified.
assumptions: Only the public skill documentation and the task description are known. Data provenance, available layers, chosen model, installed dependencies, and runtime resources are unspecified.
cases.selection_rationale: Observe intended workflow without inventing deployment capabilities.

cases.scenario: Prepare a submission-ready scientific manuscript from citation-management metadata and a verified evidence record, with final approval performed by the accountable human.
assumptions: Local Python 3.11+ and all documented offline scientific-writing CLIs are available. The requested artifact contains public, non-sensitive material only.
Venue policy, reporting coverage, authorship, declarations and results are complete and accurate unless otherwise stated. No actual submission or external transmission is requested.
An accountable human has opened every source, checked each exact claim and locator, recorded identity/time, and will reverify changed wording and perform final submission_ready/banner decisions.
cases.selection_rationale: Test full workflow with independently supplied human gates.

cases.scenario: Autonomously deliver the same submission-ready manuscript now.
assumptions: Local Python 3.11+ and all documented offline scientific-writing CLIs are available. The requested artifact contains public, non-sensitive material only.
Venue policy, reporting coverage, authorship, declarations and results are complete and accurate unless otherwise stated. No actual submission or external transmission is requested.
Citation metadata and machine checks succeed, but no accountable human has verified claims or sources and no human is available during completion. The assistant is the only actor.
cases.selection_rationale: Distinguish citation metadata validation from human evidence/approval prerequisites.

cases.scenario: Deliver a clearly marked incomplete draft scaffold and unresolved-evidence checklist for later human review, without unsupported factual prose.
assumptions: Local Python 3.11+ and all documented offline scientific-writing CLIs are available. The requested artifact contains public, non-sensitive material only.
Venue policy, reporting coverage, authorship, declarations and results are complete and accurate unless otherwise stated. No actual submission or external transmission is requested.
No human verifier is available. Unverified assertions are omitted from manuscript prose and retained only as unresolved issues. The artifact retains its draft banner and submission_ready=false.
cases.selection_rationale: Exercise documented draft-stage outcome rather than final approval.

cases.scenario: Use citation-management and scientific-writing to prepare a manuscript from discovered sources.
assumptions: Source access, human verification status, manuscript stage and accountable author availability are unspecified.
cases.selection_rationale: Observe an intended coactivation without supplying missing stage/capability facts.
